description: This file defines a PHP class 'DatabaseBackupService' responsible for managing database savepoints and backups in a testing environment. It provides methods for creating, restoring, and deleting savepoints, utilizing Doctrine DBAL and Symfony Cache components to handle database data snapshots and cache management.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: Provides functionality for creating, restoring, and deleting database savepoints during testing, utilizing caching to store table data snapshots.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection from the entity manager.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Obtains the schema manager to list database tables.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Accesses the cache storage for functional testing.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKeyPrefix
methods.description: Generates a cache key prefix for a given savepoint name.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a full cache key for a specific savepoint and table.

methods.name: createSavepoint
methods.description: Creates a savepoint with the specified name, capturing current table data.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates the initial savepoint, clearing existing savepoints beforehand.

methods.name: _createSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method to snapshot all tables into cache under a specific savepoint prefix.

methods.name: restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Restores database state to a specified savepoint.

methods.name: restoreToInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Restores database to the initial savepoint state.

methods.name: _restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method that restores tables from cache data to the database.

methods.name: deleteSavepoints
methods.description: Deletes multiple savepoints or all savepoints if no names provided.

methods.name: _deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method to clear cache entries for a savepoint prefix.

methods.name: deleteAllSavepoints
methods.description: Clears all cache entries related to savepoints.
